answer: Give every identity a terrace that shows one number: the pulse of real downstream use of its finished work. Each dawn the network re-reads every pulse and sets that identity's job quota from it: an identity whose last 20 outputs were opened, reused or paid for keeps full quota, while one whose outputs nobody touched drops to zero. A Sybil farm can mint 1,000 identities for free, but to keep their pulses alive it must fake consumption too, paying the $0.50 usage fee on 20 jobs per identity, $10,000 every epoch, forever, just to hold quotas it could never sell.
